domain: an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space E with its Borel measurable structure
hypotheses: H is {x | L x <= c} for a continuous linear functional L with norm one
stdGaussian E A = stdGaussian E H
conclusion: stdGaussian E (Metric.thickening r H) <= stdGaussian E (Metric.thickening r A)

conventions.radius: strictly positive real radius; r = 0 is deliberately outside the statement because Metric.thickening 0 A is empty
conventions.halfspace: closed affine sublevel half-space with a unit continuous-linear normal
conventions.dimension: all finite dimensions, including dimension zero; in dimension zero the half-space hypothesis is uninhabited
conventions.boundary_measures: null and full Gaussian measures need no quantile convention in the equal-measure half-space formulation
conventions.measurability: A is explicitly measurable; each open thickening is Borel-measurable

formal_status: exact target elaborated; no proof of the target claimed
